notes.text: Acha of Hutzal comes before Ashi about a vow involving his wife.
Ravina tells Rav Ashi what Rav Acha said to them; the audience is plural.
The checked Ketubot witness expressly reads Hutzal of Benjamin; Heilprin presents two places.

Proximity to Nehardea and the local attribution to Ezra remain qualified. The checked Ketubot passage does not establish either detail.
